nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

subject_definitions:
@image1 and @image2 are both Subject 1, the machine, seen from different angles.
@image3 is Subject 2, the older scavenger.
@image4 is Subject 3, the younger scavenger.
@image5 is Subject 4, the flooded hall, and gives the location, its layout and its light.

summary:
[reference generation] Two scavengers wade through the flooded hall and their torch beams find a huge machine kneeling motionless in the water.

detailed_description:
Photoreal industrial sci-fi thriller, cold desaturated grade, anamorphic lens, deep shadow with hard torch beams as the only light in frame.

[Shot 1] Inside Subject 4. Subject 2 wades in the lead, chest-deep in black standing water, sweeping his head torch slowly across the pillars. Subject 3 follows a step behind and to his left, her torch held low, her right arm carried clear of the surface. They move away from the camera into the dark. Her beam crosses something huge and settles on it: Subject 1, kneeling half-submerged, one forward limb braced in the water, entirely motionless. Both scavengers stop walking and hold still. The water stays at chest height on both of them for the whole video and the two torch beams remain the only light source. Subject 1 does not move at any point; only water shifts around it. Neither scavenger speaks, and both keep their lips closed for the entire video. The camera stays static at water level throughout.

overall_soundscape:
Continuous heavy water displacement as two people push through chest-deep standing water, with slaps and small waves breaking against unseen metal. Steady close breathing from both, no words. Under it, constant dripping from a high ceiling and the hollow low room tone of a very large flooded hall, ending on a long structural groan of settling metal. No voices anywhere in the video.

non_diegetic_music:
A single sustained low synthesiser drone, one note held under everything, no melody and no percussion, swelling very slightly as the beam lands on the machine.

subject_definitions:
@image1 and @image2 are both Subject 1, the machine, seen from different angles.
@image3 is Subject 2, Marek.
@image4 is Subject 3, Vira.
@image5 is Subject 4, the flooded hall, and gives the location, its layout and its light.

summary:
[reference generation] A scavenger forces a cable into the kneeling machine and its core lights up underwater.

detailed_description:
Photoreal industrial sci-fi thriller, cold desaturated grade, anamorphic lens, deep shadow with hard torch beams as the only light in frame.

[Shot 1] Inside Subject 4, low and close on the chest of Subject 1 at the waterline. Marek braces one boot against the machine's forelimb and forces a thick armoured cable into a socket beside the star-shaped crater, leaning his whole weight in until it seats. Vira stands a metre behind him with her torch on his hands, then lowers the beam. Deep inside Subject 1, below the waterline, a cold blue-white light comes up — faint at first, strengthening slowly and continuously across most of the video, never flaring and never pulsing, until the water around the torso glows blue from underneath and both faces are lit from below. Subject 1 does not move at any point. Both keep their lips closed for the entire video and neither speaks. The camera stays static.

overall_soundscape:
Water washing around a large submerged body throughout. A hard scrape of metal on metal as a heavy connector is forced into place, then a single deep clunk as it seats. Marek's strained breathing, no words. Under it, dripping and the hollow room tone of the flooded hall, and in the second half a very low electrical hum rising from under the water, steady, filling the rest of the video. No voices anywhere in the video.

non_diegetic_music:
The sustained low synthesiser drone thins out and drops away as the hum from the machine arrives, leaving only a single quiet held note underneath. No melody, no percussion.

subject_definitions:
@image1 and @image2 are both Subject 1, the machine, seen from different angles.
@image3 is Subject 2, Marek.
@image4 is Subject 3, Vira.
@image5 is Subject 4, the flooded hall, and gives the location, its layout and its light.

summary:
[reference generation] The machine pushes off its forelimbs and stands up onto two legs while the two scavengers hold completely still.

detailed_description:
Photoreal industrial sci-fi thriller, cold desaturated grade, anamorphic lens, blue core light from under the water and two torch beams as the only light in frame.

[Shot 1] Inside Subject 4, camera low at water level. Subject 1 is already shifting its weight as the video opens. It pushes off both forelimbs and rises onto its backward-jointed legs in one continuous unhurried movement that takes up most of the video, never springing and never settling back, water sheeting off the shoulder carapace in heavy curtains the whole way up. It stays a single mass throughout — nothing detaches, nothing swings loose — and the blue core stays lit low in the torso as it clears the surface. Marek takes one step backwards and stops. Vira does not move at all; her torch beam climbs the machine's body as it rises until she is looking almost straight up. Both keep their lips closed for the entire video and neither speaks. The camera stays static and the scale comes from Subject 1 filling more of the frame.

overall_soundscape:
An enormous displacement of water, building through the first half and falling back into heavy pouring and slapping as it drains off metal. Deep hydraulic loading and the grind of large joints taking weight, structural metal groaning under strain. The low electrical hum of the core continues underneath throughout. Two people breathing, holding their breath, no words. The tail is falling water and settling metal. No voices anywhere in the video.

non_diegetic_music:
A low sustained string cluster swelling with the movement, no percussion and no melody, cut back to a single held note as the water finishes falling.

subject_definitions:
@image1 and @image2 are both Subject 1, the machine, seen from different angles.
@image3 is Subject 2, Marek.
@image4 is Subject 3, Vira, whose right arm is machine hardware of the same make and finish as Subject 1.
@image5 is Subject 4, the flooded hall, and gives the location, its layout and its light.

summary:
[reference generation] The standing machine tilts its upper body down over the two scavengers while the camera descends with it.

detailed_description:
Photoreal industrial sci-fi thriller, cold desaturated grade, anamorphic lens, the blue core and two torch beams as the only light in frame.

[Shot 1] Inside Subject 4, three-quarter view: Subject 1 stands to the right of frame turned partly toward camera, the two scavengers small and low in the left of frame. Subject 1 tilts its whole upper carapace forward and down toward them in one slow continuous arc that takes up most of the video, unhurried and never stopping partway, until it hangs low over them and holds there. It moves as a single mass: the legs do not step, nothing detaches, and it does not touch either of them at any point. The probe and cable cluster comes to rest a hand's width from Vira's machine arm and stays there. Marek holds still with his pry bar half raised. Vira holds still, chin lifted. Neither backs away, neither speaks, and both keep their lips closed for the entire video. The camera pedestals down at slow speed with small amplitude, starting above the scavengers' heads and finishing near the waterline, staying with the descending carapace the whole way.

overall_soundscape:
The low electrical hum of the core runs the whole way through, rising slightly in pitch as the body comes down. Heavy servo movement and the strain of large joints, water streaming off the carapace and dripping onto the surface below. In the last seconds a run of small rapid mechanical clicks from the probe cluster, close to the microphone. Two people breathing shallowly, no words. No voices anywhere in the video.

N/A

summary:
[reference generation] Lights sweep at the far end of the flooded hall and the machine turns away from the scavengers to face them.

detailed_description:
Photoreal industrial sci-fi thriller, cold desaturated grade, anamorphic lens, wide.

[Shot 1] Inside Subject 4, high angle from a gantry looking steeply down at the water. Subject 1 stands in the middle of frame with the blue core the only light on its body, Marek and Vira small beside its right leg. At the far end of the hall hard white beams begin sweeping across the water and across the pillars, fast, crossing each other and throwing long shadows down the hall. Nothing is ever visible down there except the moving light. Subject 1 turns its whole body away from the two scavengers to face the far end in one continuous unhurried turn, and holds facing that way for the rest of the video. Marek turns his head toward the lights. Vira switches her torch off. Neither speaks and both keep their lips closed for the entire video. The camera stays static and high.

overall_soundscape:
Water washing against pillars, and the low hum of the core continuing underneath. From the far end, heavy dull impacts carrying through the water rather than through the air, spaced and unhurried, growing slightly closer across the video. The scrape of a large body turning in deep water. A single small click as a torch is switched off. Two people breathing, no words. The last seconds are water settling and one more distant impact. No voices anywhere in the video.

non_diegetic_music:
A low synthesiser pulse enters quietly, one repeated note at a slow steady rate, no melody, building very slightly in level across the video.

subject_definitions:
@image1 and @image2 are both Subject 1, the machine, seen from behind and from the side.
@image3 is Subject 2, Marek, whose left leg below the knee is a heavy industrial prosthetic.
@image4 is Subject 3, Vira.

[reference generation] Three shots: the machine backs down the hall taking hits while the two scavengers keep moving above it.

detailed_description:
Photoreal industrial sci-fi thriller, cold desaturated grade, anamorphic lens, handheld throughout.

[Shot 1] Inside Subject 4, long lens looking straight down the length of the hall at water level. Subject 1 backs toward the camera on all fours, steady and unhurried, never turning away from the far end. Hard white beams flare behind it and impacts strike its front, throwing sparks and spray. Nothing is ever visible beyond it except the moving light. The camera retreats ahead of it, one direction.

[Shot 2] At 00:05.000, cut in close on the machine's chest plate beside the old star-shaped crater as fresh impacts land: metal deforms and spalls, sparks wash across the plating, the blue core still lit behind it. The camera drifts slowly across the plating, unsteady and human.

[Shot 3] At 00:09.000, cut to high on the walkway behind Marek and Vira as they move away along the grating, both glancing back down at Subject 1 shrinking below them. Vira moves quickly, Marek heavy and uneven on his prosthetic. Both breathe hard with open mouths and neither forms any words. The camera follows behind them, one direction.

overall_soundscape:
Repeated heavy impacts on metal, close and hard, with sparks hissing into water. Water surging around a very large body backing through it. The low hum of the core underneath, straining. From above, boots on wet grating, two sets at different rhythms, one with a metallic clank every second stride, and two people breathing hard. No words and no voices anywhere in the video.

non_diegetic_music:
Low sustained strings under a slow hard pulse, building in level, no melody, thinning out in the last seconds.

detailed_description:

[Shot 1] Inside Subject 4, tight on Vira already outside in the open, wading forward through shallow water with wet concrete and falling rain behind her and nothing else in frame. Daylight flattens across her face after the dark, wet hair stuck to her forehead, rain running off her. She stops. Marek comes into frame behind her, slower and heavier on his prosthetic. Both breathe hard with open mouths and neither forms any words. The camera drifts in toward her, unsteady and human.

[Shot 2] At 00:05.000, cut to behind them looking back at the outfall: a broad square-cut opening in a massive concrete dam wall, wide and tall enough for Subject 1 to walk out of standing, dwarfing the two of them, water pouring out over a silted apron. The daylight reaches only the first few metres of wet wall inside and everything deeper falls away into black, with one faint blue point a long way back in it. Rain blows across the whole face of the wall. Vira turns and looks back into the opening and does not move. Marek keeps going out of frame. The camera pushes slowly toward the opening, one direction.

overall_soundscape:
Heavy rain on concrete and on shallow water, continuous and close, a hard contrast to the enclosed sound before. Water pouring out over stone. Two people wading out of deeper water, then breathing hard in the open. From far back inside, muffled heavy impacts still carrying, distant and flattened by the rain. No voices anywhere in the video.

Rain streams off the shoulder carapace and runs down the plating. Water moves around its feet. The camera arcs slowly around it in one direction, unsteady and human, never stopping, so the blue core stays visible low in the torso.

[Shot 2] At 00:06.000, cut in close on the chest plate beside the old star-shaped crater, rain hitting the metal. The blue core dims slowly and continuously across the whole rest of the video, never flickering and never pulsing, fading down until nothing is lit and only wet grey metal is left. Subject 1 does not move at any point. The camera pushes in slowly, one direction.

Heavy rain on metal and on shallow water throughout, close and constant. Water running out over stone. The low electrical hum of the core continues under it, falling slowly in pitch and level across the video and cutting out entirely near the end, leaving only rain. No impacts, no movement, and no voices anywhere in the video.

non_diegetic_music:
A single sustained low note held very quietly under the rain, no melody and no percussion, fading out with the core and leaving the last seconds unscored.
